data.text: Yes, Jack—I support 10 tons each. My family depended on this lake, and I want our village to keep earning from it for years. Equal shares give everyone a reason to stick with the agreement, rather than argue each month over who gets less. I’ll commit to 10 tons if everyone agrees, and we can review the catches together afterward. John, you haven’t weighed in yet—will you support that? Luke and Emma, can you accept equal shares too?
